derivation:
by
  apply ContinuousAffineMap.toAffineMap_injective
  exact AffineEquiv.coe_trans_to_affineMap e.toAffineEquiv e'.toAffineEquiv
explanation: Specialize the affine-equivalence composition identity to the underlying affine equivalences. Injectivity of the forgetful map lifts the resulting equality to continuous affine maps. The candidate is independently proved by rfl.
